sentences.text:
Narayan Chandra Paul vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 7
December, 2016

1 
164 07.12.2016
rkd Ct. No.28 C.R.R. 3845 of 2016 Narayan Chandra Paul
-vs-
The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Rajdeep Majumder, Mr. Moyukh Mukherjee, Ms. Shyanti Poddar .....for the petitioner.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the registration of first information report under the provision of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act is unwarranted as the said law stood repealed at the time of commission of alleged offence.

It is further submitted that the impugned first information report was registered to circumvent the provision of Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 is not maintainable in law.
Let this matter appear under the heading "Motion Adjourned" one week hence.
Mr. Gupta, learned counsel for the State, is requested to appear in the matter and produce the case diary on the next date of hearing.
Copy of the petition be served upon him in course of the day.
Certified copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the parties on a priority basis.
